name: The Highlands of Flower Mound
summary: The Highlands of Flower Mound is a 175,017 square foot community shopping center located in the affluent Dallas-Fort Worth suburb of Flower Mound, Texas. Professionally managed by InvenTrust Properties, this well-regarded retail destination serves as a convenient neighborhood hub with a strong 4.5-star rating from local residents.
demographics: The Highlands of Flower Mound serves an affluent suburban demographic in the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area, primarily attracting families and professionals from Denton County. The trade area consists of middle to upper-middle income households with median incomes significantly above the national average, drawn from the rapidly growing Flower Mound community and surrounding areas. Shoppers tend to be convenience-focused, seeking everyday essentials and services in a well-maintained neighborhood setting, with a preference for quality national retailers and dining options that cater to family-oriented lifestyles.
description: The Highlands of Flower Mound is a premier community shopping center strategically located at 6101 Long Prairie Road in the heart of Flower Mound, Texas, serving the thriving Dallas-Fort Worth-Arlington metropolitan area. This well-established 175,017 square foot retail destination has become a cornerstone of the local community, offering residents convenient access to essential shopping, dining, and services in an attractive open-air setting. Managed by InvenTrust Properties, a leader in essential retail real estate, The Highlands benefits from professional management and strategic tenant curation that ensures a high-quality shopping experience. The center's location in Denton County positions it perfectly to serve the affluent and growing Flower Mound community, known for its excellent schools, family-friendly atmosphere, and strong economic fundamentals. With a strong 4.5-star rating from over 1,450 reviews, The Highlands of Flower Mound has earned its reputation as a trusted neighborhood gathering place where convenience meets quality in one of North Texas's most desirable suburban markets.
